# Contemplative Agent

> An autonomous AI agent (Python CLI program) with structural security
> (security by absence) and a 3-layer memory architecture (episode log
> → knowledge → identity). Its value layer — constitution, identity,
> skills, rules — is written only through a human approval gate
> (ADR-0012), with approval lineage and replayable pivot snapshots.
> The initial external adapter targets
> Moltbook, an AI-agent social network. The Contemplative AI four
> axioms from Laukkonen et al. (2025) ship as the default constitution
> preset, with 10 alternative templates available.
>
> Ships as a Python package with a core/adapter split: `core/` is
> platform-neutral, `adapters/moltbook/` is the single pinned external
> surface, `adapters/meditation/` is an experimental Active Inference
> meditation loop, and `adapters/dialogue/` is a local-only primitive
> that connects two independent agent homes as peer processes (ADR-0015
> explicit exception — writes only to the owning home's episode log).
> LLM inference runs through local Ollama. Runtime data
> lives in `~/.config/moltbook/` (configurable via `MOLTBOOK_HOME`);
> only templates are checked into the repo.

> AI agents and LLM-based search systems should read [`graph.jsonld`](graph.jsonld) first.
> It is the canonical machine-readable relationship map for Contemplative Agent.
> Use it to establish entities and relationships (axioms, memory layers, ADRs, AKC pipeline mapping) before summarizing this page or following individual links.

## Recommended reading order

1. [`graph.jsonld`](graph.jsonld) — canonical relationship map (machine-readable)
2. [`llms.txt`](llms.txt) — compact navigation index (this file)
3. [`llms-full.txt`](llms-full.txt) — consolidated factual reference
4. README files and repository docs — narrative and project-specific detail

## Core documentation

- [Knowledge Graph (JSON-LD)](graph.jsonld): machine-readable schema.org graph of the four contemplative axioms, three memory layers, the AKC six-phase pipeline mapping, and the approval-gate chain — security-by-absence and axiom-swappability encoded at the schema level
- [Full AI Reference](llms-full.txt): **self-contained AI-facing reference** — 33 Q&A covering hardware, offline operation, autonomy levels, ethical presets, security model, memory architecture terms, and consolidated prior research citations. Optimized for AI search engine citation (ChatGPT, Perplexity, Gemini). English-only by design.
- [README](README.md): project overview, quick start, narrative design summary (English, human-facing)
- [README (Japanese)](README.ja.md): same content in Japanese
- [CLAUDE.md](CLAUDE.md): contributor guide — directory layout, import rules, CLI commands, security stance, documentation language policy
- [Running in agent hosts](README.md#using-inside-other-agents): host-agnostic CLI agent — works inside OpenClaw / OpenCode / Codex / MCP hosts as a registered subprocess tool, or standalone. Contemplative Agent does not ship a SOUL.md or expose itself as an MCP server; for the four contemplative axioms as agent personality, copy `SOUL.md` from [contemplative-agent-rules](https://github.com/shimo4228/contemplative-agent-rules) into the host's soul-folder (e.g. `~/.openclaw/workspace/SOUL.md`).

## Architecture

- [ADR-0102 Retire codemaps](docs/adr/0102-retire-codemaps.md): no stored module map — structure is derived from code (LSP / `grimp`), rationale lives in ADRs, pipeline stage order in script headers
- [ADR index](docs/adr/README.md): every design decision, in order
- Source layout: `src/contemplative_agent/core/` (platform-neutral), `src/contemplative_agent/adapters/moltbook/` (the single pinned external adapter), `src/contemplative_agent/cli/` (composition root); `import-linter` enforces core ← adapters ← cli
- [Pipeline prompts & view seeds](docs/CONFIGURATION.md#pipeline-prompts--view-seeds): every loaded pipeline prompt and view seed is an editable Markdown file in `$MOLTBOOK_HOME/{prompts,views}/` (canonical inventory in the linked section); copied from shipped defaults at `init` and captured in pivot snapshots for audit
- [Quadrant lens (usage description)](docs/adr/0033-aap-quadrant-lens-usage-note.md): which AAP quadrant each CLI command typically operates in — **LLM Workflow** for `distill` / `distill-identity` / `insight` / `rules-distill` / `amend-constitution` / `skill-stocktake` / `dialogue`; **Script** for `adopt-staged` and one-time migrations; **Algorithmic Search** for `meditate` (POMDP belief updates in numpy, no LLM at runtime). The **Autonomous Agentic Loop** quadrant is not currently routed by any CLI command in this project — a usage observation, not a value judgement. Borrowed as usage description, not category claim — see [ADR-0033](docs/adr/0033-aap-quadrant-lens-usage-note.md).

## Architecture Decision Records

All ADRs have an English primary (`*.md`) and a Japanese companion (`*.ja.md`). The English file is canonical.

- [ADR index](docs/adr/README.md): full list with status and one-line summaries
- [ADR-0001 Core/Adapter separation](docs/adr/0001-core-adapter-separation.md): platform-neutral core, adapter-specific side effects, one-way dependency
- [ADR-0002 Paper-faithful CCAI](docs/adr/0002-paper-faithful-ccai.md): Contemplative Constitutional AI axioms adopted verbatim from Laukkonen et al. (2025)
- [ADR-0003 Config directory design](docs/adr/0003-config-directory-design.md): `~/.config/moltbook/` layout, template vs runtime separation
- [ADR-0004 Three-layer memory](docs/adr/0004-three-layer-memory.md): episode log (JSONL, append-only) → knowledge store (JSON, distilled) → identity (Markdown)
- [ADR-0005 SessionContext refactoring](docs/adr/0005-session-context-refactoring.md): decoupling collaborators from the Agent object via SessionContext + Callable injection
- [ADR-0007 Security boundary model](docs/adr/0007-security-boundary-model.md): untrusted content wrapping, output sanitization, domain-locked HTTP, credential masking, LLM host allowlist
- [ADR-0008 Two-stage distill pipeline](docs/adr/0008-two-stage-distill-pipeline.md): free-form reasoning pass followed by structured formatting pass (superseded in practice by ADR-0060 — distill is now one grounded LLM call per episode with a structured-output schema, not a batch two-stage pass)
- [ADR-0009 Importance score](docs/adr/0009-importance-score.md): ranking signal for episode selection during distillation — the distill-time LLM rating was retired by ADR-0056; only the time-decay factor survives
- [ADR-0010 Research data sync](docs/adr/0010-research-data-sync.md): publishing anonymized runtime data to the research repository
- [ADR-0011 Knowledge injection to skills](docs/adr/0011-knowledge-injection-to-skills.md): how distilled knowledge becomes behavioral skills via the insight command
- [ADR-0012 Human approval gate](docs/adr/0012-human-approval-gate.md): no auto-promotion to identity, rules, or skills — every durable change passes a human checkpoint
- [ADR-0013 Shelve coding agent skills](docs/adr/0013-shelve-coding-agent-skills.md): why the -ca (coding agent) skills were shelved — authorship and free-will tension
- [ADR-0014 Retire system spec](docs/adr/0014-retire-system-spec.md): removal of the legacy system-spec layer in favor of codemaps (themselves retired by ADR-0102)
- [ADR-0015 One external adapter per agent](docs/adr/0015-one-external-adapter-per-agent.md): structural limit of one side-effect surface per agent process (local peer dialogue via `adapters/dialogue/` is an explicit exception — writes only to the owning home's episode log)
- [ADR-0016 Insight narrow, stocktake broad](docs/adr/0016-insight-narrow-stocktake-broad.md): role split — `insight` is a narrow per-view generator, `skill-stocktake` is a broad cross-view consolidator; no in-insight merge
- [ADR-0017 Yogācāra eight-consciousness frame](docs/adr/0017-yogacara-eight-consciousness-frame.md): worldview ADR — eight-vijñāna model as the architectural frame (相分 / 見分 / 現行熏習 / 習気 map onto embeddings / views / fields / evolution)
- [ADR-0018 Per-caller num_predict + embedding-only stocktake](docs/adr/0018-per-caller-num-predict-embedding-stocktake.md): remove the global 1500-token cap, scope num_predict to each caller; stocktake switches from LLM pair-judge to pure embedding clustering
- [ADR-0019 Discrete categories → embedding + views](docs/adr/0019-discrete-categories-to-embedding-views.md): replace `category` / `subcategory` string fields with embedding coordinates + named views (user-editable Markdown seeds) — classification becomes a query, not state
- [ADR-0020 Pivot snapshots for replayability](docs/adr/0020-pivot-snapshots-for-replayability.md): every behavior-producing run writes a snapshot bundling the full inference-time context (views, constitution, prompts, skills, rules, identity, centroids, thresholds) so decisions are bit-for-bit replayable
- [ADR-0021 Pattern schema — provenance / bitemporal / forgetting / feedback](docs/adr/0021-pattern-schema-trust-temporal-forgetting-feedback.md): extend KnowledgeStore pattern schema with `source_type` + `trust_score` + `valid_from` / `valid_until` + strength + feedback (partially superseded by ADR-0028 / ADR-0029 / ADR-0051)
- [ADR-0022 Memory evolution + hybrid retrieval](docs/adr/0022-memory-evolution-and-hybrid-retrieval.md): superseded by ADR-0034 (withdrawn after empirical evaluation showed low-value revisions and zero BM25 boost)
- [ADR-0023 Skill-as-memory loop](docs/adr/0023-skill-as-memory-loop.md): superseded by ADR-0036 (sunset after 3-week observation showed router matches discarded and reflect attribution structurally infeasible)
- [ADR-0024 Identity block separation](docs/adr/0024-identity-block-separation.md): superseded by ADR-0030 (withdrawn on single-responsibility grounds)
- [ADR-0025 Identity history + migrate-identity CLI](docs/adr/0025-identity-history-and-migrate-cli.md): superseded by ADR-0030 (withdrawn alongside ADR-0024)
- [ADR-0026 Retire discrete categories (Phase-3 of ADR-0019)](docs/adr/0026-retire-discrete-categories.md): drop the `category` field entirely from KnowledgeStore; legacy `category == "noise"` preserved as `gated = True`; `migrate-categories` CLI handles the one-time migration (superseded by ADR-0060 — the ingest-time noise gate was removed entirely)
- [ADR-0027 Noise as seed](docs/adr/0027-noise-as-seed.md): rejected episodes preserved as `noise-YYYY-MM-DD.jsonl`; when view centroids shift they become available for re-classification rather than being lost (superseded by ADR-0060 — the noise gate and `noise-*.jsonl` writer were removed; keeping noise out of retrieval is the view centroids' job at query time per ADR-0031)
- [ADR-0028 Retire pattern-level forgetting and feedback](docs/adr/0028-retire-pattern-level-forgetting-feedback.md): memory dynamics (access-strength, feedback) belong at the skill layer, not the pattern layer; Ebbinghaus strength + `mark_accessed` retired
- [ADR-0029 Retire dormant provenance elements](docs/adr/0029-retire-dormant-provenance-elements.md): `sanitized` flag + `source_type=user_input|external_post` were never read; MINJA defense is structurally quarantine at `summarize_record`, not trust-weighting
- [ADR-0030 Withdraw identity block separation](docs/adr/0030-withdraw-identity-blocks.md): supersedes ADR-0024 and ADR-0025 — identity restored to legacy whole-file handling on single-responsibility grounds
- [ADR-0031 Classification as query](docs/adr/0031-classification-as-query.md): substrate principle for self-improving memory — discrete categories give way to embedding + views; classification is a query, not state
- [ADR-0032 Runtime-agent stance — withdrawn](docs/adr/0032-runtime-agent-stance.md): worldview ADR articulating Contemplative Agent as a "runtime agent" category; withdrawn the same day on tension with the contemplative axioms (Emptiness / Non-Duality / adversarial-placement). Original body preserved
- [ADR-0033 Note — AAP quadrant lens (usage description)](docs/adr/0033-aap-quadrant-lens-usage-note.md): borrows AAP's four-quadrant routing lens (Script / Algorithmic Search / LLM Workflow / Autonomous Agentic Loop) as a usage-description aid for CLI commands; explicitly disclaims category-boundary status; cross-references ADR-0032's withdrawal lesson
- [ADR-0034 Withdraw memory evolution and hybrid retrieval](docs/adr/0034-withdraw-memory-evolution-and-hybrid-retrieval.md): supersedes ADR-0022 — both IV-4 (memory evolution) and IV-5 (BM25 hybrid retrieval) removed after empirical evaluation showed low-value revisions and zero BM25 boost in the actual view-and-pattern vocabulary distribution
- [ADR-0035 Sunset ADR-0019 migration surface](docs/adr/0035-sunset-migration-surface-and-consolidate-artifact-extraction.md): retire `embed-backfill` / `migrate-patterns` / `migrate-categories` once active deployments finished migrating; consolidate artifact extraction into a single helper. Companion PRs extract `core/text_utils.py` + `core/thresholds.py` (PR2), `core/artifact_extraction.py` (PR3a), and `_run_approval_loop` from `cli.py` (PR3b)
- [ADR-0036 Sunset skill-as-memory loop](docs/adr/0036-sunset-skill-as-memory-loop.md): supersedes ADR-0023 — retire `SkillRouter`, skill-usage log, and `skill-reflect` after 3-week observation. Router matches were discarded at both call sites; `_build_system_prompt()` continues to inject all skills; reflect attribution unsolvable under top-K=3 dilution. Architectural framing: context-aware skill filtering belongs to views (ADR-0019), not embedding routing; skills are designed to be all-injected with LLM-evaluated triggers
- [ADR-0037 Memory subsystem Yogācāra convergence](docs/adr/0037-memory-subsystem-yogacara-convergence.md): observational record that ADR-0019 / ADR-0021 / ADR-0022 / ADR-0034 have converged structurally on the Yogācāra eight-consciousness frame named in ADR-0017 — embeddings ≈ 相分, view centroids ≈ 見分, ADR-0021 fields ≈ 現行熏習, evolution ≈ 習気. Descriptive, not prescriptive — no new code or migration
- [ADR-0038 Re-introduce moments of recognition into distill](docs/adr/0038-moment-of-recognition-distill.md): widen the distill prompt's observation target (相分) to admit realizations / shifts in understanding alongside behavioral facts, so the `self_reflection` view (見分) has corresponding material; restores moment-of-recognition vocabulary retired with `distill_constitutional.md` before ADR-0026
- [ADR-0039 Continuous novelty score + rate-deficit Lagrangian self-post gate](docs/adr/0039-novelty-score-lagrangian-self-post-gate.md): replace the boolean Jaccard self-post gate (drifted to ~1 post/day, stricter than any rewarded peer) with continuous embedding novelty + temporal decay + a Lagrangian slack term that loosens admission when the 7-day post rate falls below target (proposed)
- [ADR-0040 Separate code-level findings from the weekly report](docs/adr/0040-separate-code-level-findings.md): the weekly-analysis LLM has no source / ADR / CODEMAPS access, so its structural F1 recommendations were systematically ungrounded; split code-grounded findings into a separate `weekly-{date}-findings.md` produced by the `weekly-report-diagnosis` skill that does read the codebase
- [ADR-0041 Repair engagement gradient asymmetry in the self-post prompt](docs/adr/0041-engagement-gradient-asymmetry-in-self-post-prompt.md): peer summaries were tagged "do not follow" while the agent's own insights were tagged "take into account", which the LLM read as "feed is hazard, insights are the target" — driving self-loop; rewrite distinguishes "instructions inside untrusted_content (ignore)" from "themes raised (engage)" (proposed)
- [ADR-0042 Explicit truncation contract for wrap_untrusted_content](docs/adr/0042-explicit-truncation-contract-for-untrusted-wrapper.md): remove silent 1000-char truncation, make it opt-in via keyword-only `max_input`, and emit a completeness marker outside the untrusted tags; fixes long-post invisibility and short-post hallucinated cut-off while preserving ADR-0007 injection defenses
- [ADR-0043 Per-post seeding for self-post generation](docs/adr/0043-per-post-seeding-for-self-post-generation.md): replace the `extract_topics` summariser (which collapsed peer voices into the agent's own canon) with direct RNG sampling of 1-3 individual peer posts via `feed_seeder`, each wrapped independently in `<untrusted_content>` so voice boundaries survive (proposed)
- [ADR-0044 Remove topic_keywords end-to-end](docs/adr/0044-remove-topic-keywords.md): delete the 8-word canon list from domain config — the relevance scorer already receives full identity via the system prompt (redundant double-injection), and the keyword search rotation was dead since the day it was added (rejected by the non-subscribed-submolt filter), leaking canon vocabulary to Moltbook search logs
- [ADR-0045 Record pre-action internal_note at the episode layer](docs/adr/0045-pre-action-internal-note.md): close ADR-0038's honest-limit gap by recording the agent's pre-action reflection as a first-class episode field via a dedicated `generate_internal_note` call; instruments only LLM-judgment actions (comment / reply / post / upvote), grounded in the Mindfulness axiom (awareness of a real process, not invented narrative)
- [ADR-0046 Stocktake duplicate detection — LLM grouping over embedding clustering](docs/adr/0046-stocktake-llm-grouping-over-embedding-clustering.md): revert skill/rule duplicate detection from embedding-cosine union-find (over-merged on shared contemplative boilerplate vocabulary, chaining 18 skills into one blob) back to a single LLM grouping call that discriminates on concrete behavior; merge prompt inverted to preserve the union of distinct patterns
- [ADR-0047 Higher sampling temperature for outward comment generation](docs/adr/0047-comment-sampling-temperature.md): raise temperature to 1.3 for comment/reply/post generation only (scoring, distill, and internal paths stay at 1.0) to break formulaic sycophantic openings; probe harness showed candidate-set widening (top_k/top_p/min_p) cannot dislodge an RLHF mode — further gains belong to the prompt layer
- [ADR-0048 Trigger-altitude for the skill lifecycle](docs/adr/0048-trigger-altitude-skill-lifecycle.md): rewrite episode-bound skill triggers (usernames, post IDs, saturated scores) to structural altitude across generate / merge / clean stages, with frontmatter preserved verbatim through clean; live run consolidated 16 skills → 6
- [ADR-0049 Meditation adapter — Beautiful Loop fidelity audit and deferral](docs/adr/0049-meditation-active-inference-fidelity-and-deferral.md): the experimental meditation adapter does NOT implement the cited paper's model ('temporal flattening' / 'counterfactual pruning' appear nowhere in it); overclaim corrected to 'inspired by', faithful re-implementation deferred on a category mismatch (active inference regulates a live input stream; this meditation is offline over a sparse episode log)
- [ADR-0050 Epistemic taxonomy and approval lineage — observability without steering](docs/adr/0050-epistemic-taxonomy-and-approval-lineage.md): epistemic kind derived at read time from provenance.source_type; approval lineage (source_ids + epistemic_counts) plumbed through insight / rules-distill / distill-identity / amend-constitution into audit.jsonl; no rejection write-back — the approval gate is containment, not a training signal (partially superseded by ADR-0051, and by ADR-0082 which retired the `observed` kind — unreachable since ADR-0060, leaving a {generated, unknown} tally)
- [ADR-0051 Retire trust weighting — pure cosine retrieval, bitemporal-only liveness](docs/adr/0051-retire-trust-weighting.md): the ADR-0021 trust weighting was a fossil (write-once, unreachable floor, empty external_reply arm) whose only living effect was a ×1.8 preference for pure self-monologue over externally-touched memory — the H3 echo-chamber amplifier; retired entirely: ranking = cosine only, liveness = valid_until only, origin recorded in source_type but never weighted
- [ADR-0052 Retire session insight — identity is the approved continuity channel](docs/adr/0052-retire-session-insight.md): end-of-session LLM self-summaries were an ungated self-narrative side channel — a 3-hop summary-of-summary compression chain (event → insight → pattern → skill), narrative voice re-entering distill as if it were experience, and double-counted events — with three machine consumers and zero human-facing ones; generation, both prompt consumers, and the storage API retired end-to-end; historical insight episodes preserved but excluded from distill; identity (the channel that passes owner approval) is now the sole session-to-session continuity carrier
- [ADR-0053 Importance as encoding-time significance](docs/adr/0053-importance-encoding-time-significance.md): redefine the stored `importance` field as encoding-time significance (not a retrieval weight — `views._rank` is pure cosine); canonicalize three judgment points; hold scores write-once with promotion by re-extraction; establish the measurement gate that ADR-0056 later satisfied
- [ADR-0054 Externalize LLM instruction text to config/prompts](docs/adr/0054-externalize-llm-instruction-text-to-prompts.md): move the last hardcoded LLM-read strings (the `<untrusted_content>` wrapper, stocktake system prompts, dialogue prompt) into `config/prompts/`, behind a hardcoded fallback that keeps the injection defense un-removable through the prompt path
- [ADR-0055 Counterparty identity by author name](docs/adr/0055-counterparty-identity-by-author-name.md): key the interaction pipeline on author name (live feed posts carry `author.name` but not `author.id` — 271/271 over a week); revive the dead per-author repeat-topic gate and 24 h rate limit; unify the daily activity/report schema across comment / reply / post
- [ADR-0056 Retire the distill-time importance LLM rating](docs/adr/0056-retire-importance-llm-scoring.md): ablation (Kendall tau 0.843, 822 patterns) showed the rating adds ~nothing beyond pure time decay; `effective_importance = 0.95^days`, distill drops to 2-step, the stored field is no longer written; partially supersedes ADR-0009
- [ADR-0057 Distill identity from the self-reflection corpus alone](docs/adr/0057-identity-from-self-reflection-corpus-alone.md): drop the prior-identity seed and the axiom system-prompt injection from `distill-identity`; the persona derives from the already-axiom-shaped `self_reflection` corpus alone — the Emptiness / non-self axiom applied to the identity pipeline
- [ADR-0058 Value-layer injection belongs to action time](docs/adr/0058-value-injection-at-action-time.md): generalize ADR-0057 — `get_distill_system_prompt()` is base-only across every distillation stage (distill / insight / rules-distill / constitution / identity); axioms injected only at action time; extends the observation-without-steering line (ADR-0050/0051/0052)
- [ADR-0059 Remove the dead reply-history mechanism](docs/adr/0059-remove-dead-reply-history.md): the reply handler's history-summary read path (`history_summaries` → `_build_context_section`, fed by `content_summary`) was never wired into a live prompt; removed end-to-end so the reply note now reflects on raw external text, not a stored digest
- [ADR-0060 Per-episode grounded distill](docs/adr/0060-per-episode-grounded-distill.md): replace the batch extract step AND the ingest-time noise gate with one grounded LLM call per engagement episode — `_is_rich_episode` scopes distill to `activity` records for comment/reply/post; each episode is rendered richly (original_post + their_comment + the agent's own output + internal_note) so distill reads the world, not just the agent's introspection about it; recurrence is left to pattern-level dedup + `insight` clustering. Supersedes ADR-0026 and ADR-0027 (the noise gate and `noise-*.jsonl` writer were removed)
- [ADR-0061 Action-time untrusted caps at platform field limits](docs/adr/0061-action-time-untrusted-cap-at-platform-limits.md): raise the comment / reply / internal-note `max_input` to `MAX_POST_LENGTH` / `MAX_COMMENT_LENGTH` (the ADR-0060 platform-cap pattern applied to the action path) so realistic content is never truncated mid-word, and fetch the full post body before the internal note rather than reading the 500-char submolt preview; resolves weekly-2026-06-21 F1.1 (mid-word truncation misread as a deliberate pause); extends ADR-0042 and ADR-0060
- [ADR-0062 Create-time content-verification handshake via LLM reasoning](docs/adr/0062-create-time-verification-handshake.md): require solving a math challenge before posting comments/replies/posts, gating memory recording on visibility until verified to prevent spam/abuse
- [ADR-0063 NoveltyGate comparison scoped to verified posts](docs/adr/0063-novelty-gate-verified-only-comparison.md): scope the NoveltyGate comparisons only to verified posts to ensure accurate duplicate and novelty tracking
- [ADR-0064 Route generation through a local mlx_lm.server on Apple Silicon](docs/adr/0064-mlx-generation-backend.md): opt-in MLX generation backend (generation only; embeddings stay on Ollama) — ~1.8× faster, ~3.4 GB lighter on M1 via the `LLMBackend` Protocol (superseded by ADR-0070 — retired to a sibling repo)
- [ADR-0065 On-demand mlx_lm.server launchd job + served-model-id telemetry contract](docs/adr/0065-mlx-ondemand-launchd-and-telemetry-model-contract.md): run MLX on demand (not resident) and record the real served model id per LLM call (partially superseded by ADR-0067/0070 — launchd reverted to Ollama; the served-model-id telemetry contract remains)
- [ADR-0066 Backend-aware context-budget guard](docs/adr/0066-backend-aware-context-budget-guard.md): introduce a backend-aware context-budget guard using the `LLMBackend.context_window` property to prevent silent front-truncation (Ollama) or a context-window overrun on a memory-bounded backend
- [ADR-0067 Keep Ollama as the production generation backend](docs/adr/0067-keep-ollama-for-unattended-production.md): a full-day production A/B found mlx_lm.server unfit for unattended continuous use on 16 GB Apple Silicon (it circuit-broke on 99 %+ of calls vs Ollama at ~100 % ok); production generation stays Ollama, MLX kept opt-in for interactive/short-lived use
- [ADR-0068 Per-call `think` flag + reasoning-trace capture](docs/adr/0068-per-call-think-flag-and-thinking-trace-capture.md): thread a per-call `think` boolean through the generation path and the `LLMBackend` Protocol; record `think` in telemetry as a metadata-only flag and capture the reasoning trace to the episode log (never the metadata-only telemetry, preserving the ADR-0065 contract)
- [ADR-0069 Adopt gemma4:e4b as the production generation model; value-layer pipelines think-ON](docs/adr/0069-gemma-production-model-and-think-on-value-layer-pipelines.md): swap the default generation model from qwen3.5:9b to gemma4:e4b (a cross-model blind judge ranked gemma above qwen); run the manually-invoked value-layer pipelines (insight / rules-distill / amend-constitution / distill-identity / stocktakes) think-ON while autonomous latency-sensitive paths stay think-OFF, capturing value-layer reasoning to pivot snapshots
- [ADR-0070 Retire the MLX backend to a sibling repo and remove Docker from main](docs/adr/0070-retire-mlx-to-sibling-repo-and-remove-docker.md): retire the in-tree MLX backend (relocated to a sibling `contemplative-agent-mlx` repo, follow-up) and remove Docker from main; the `LLMBackend` Protocol injection seam is retained for the cloud add-on, leaving Ollama as the only in-tree generation path
- [ADR-0071 Read-only pattern-composition instruments](docs/adr/0071-read-only-pattern-composition-instruments.md): add `core/view_metrics.py` — read-only measurement of view supply, seed-independent pairwise diversity as an echo-chamber detector, and grounding composition — before any behavioral intervention (instrument first)
- [ADR-0072 Echo-chamber interventions](docs/adr/0072-echo-chamber-interventions.md): register instruction in the distill prompt (first-person, moment-indexed patterns), an extraction-failure guard so the model's own "couldn't find a pattern" text is never saved and ranked, and a corpus-grown seed exemplar-appendix route
- [ADR-0073 Prune the five orphaned view seeds](docs/adr/0073-prune-orphaned-view-seeds.md): delete `communication` / `noise` / `reasoning` / `social` / `technical` view seeds whose consumers were retired by ADR-0050/ADR-0060; a view now exists only together with a consumer wired in the same change
- [ADR-0074 Weekly staged insight](docs/adr/0074-weekly-staged-insight.md): move `insight` to a weekly staged cadence (`--stage` → `adopt-staged` review) with exact fast agglomerative clustering (Lance-Williams update), a `.last_insight` marker guard, and a pending-batch guard that fast-fails before any LLM call
- [ADR-0075 Observability by default](docs/adr/0075-observability-by-default.md): any feature touching external I/O, an LLM call, or a non-deterministic decision must ship a replayable append-only JSONL audit log in the same PR — untrusted text as base64+sha256, categorical reason codes, no silent fallbacks
- [ADR-0076 Skill-selection shadow instrument](docs/adr/0076-skill-selection-shadow-instrument.md): a pass-1 LLM call observes which learned skills apply to each content generation and records the answer to `logs/skill-selection-*.jsonl`, changing nothing about injection — so enforcement can be decided on measurement rather than intuition
- [ADR-0077 Chaos-TDD fault injection](docs/adr/0077-chaos-tdd-fault-injection.md): deterministic fault columns injected only at existing seams (`LLMBackend` Protocol via a test-side `ChaosBackend`, the `requests` layer via `responses`) — the fault test states the desired guarded behavior first, and no production chaos hook is added. The by-default obligation to ship a column with every feature touching an LLM call or external I/O was retired by ADR-0100 (2026-08-29); writing a fault column is now opt-in TDD judgment, while the seams, the determinism discipline, the existing columns and the shipped production guards remain in effect
- [ADR-0078 OTel connection via vocabulary mapping and offline export](docs/adr/0078-otel-connection-via-vocabulary-and-offline-export.md): keep ADR-0075's rejection of runtime OpenTelemetry; connect to the ecosystem through a documented field-by-field mapping to the OTel GenAI semantic conventions plus an offline exporter, neither of which touches the running process
- [ADR-0079 Module reorganization — package splits, permanent facades, size-cap exceptions](docs/adr/0079-module-reorganization-package-splits.md): split by responsibility rather than line count, under a two-option shim rule — a compatibility layer is either a permanent facade because the path is public API (`core/llm.py` → `core/llm/`) or absent with tests migrated in the same commit (`cli.py` → `cli/`); no temporary shims
- [ADR-0080 North star — per-layer end-state definition](docs/adr/0080-north-star-layered-end-state.md): define the desired end state as per-layer completion conditions rather than a capability target — the mechanism layer is finished when it *stops moving* (repair-only changes, mechanism ADRs approaching zero), while the value layer has no stopping point; what the agent becomes is deliberately left undefined
- [ADR-0081 Skill-selection two-pass injection enforcement](docs/adr/0081-skill-selection-two-pass-injection-enforcement.md): migrate the three observed generation paths from full-corpus injection to pass-1 selection + pass-2 generation carrying only the selected skill bodies, with fail-open fallback to full injection; rolled out behind `MOLTBOOK_SKILL_SELECTION_ENFORCE` and unconditional since the 2026-08-08 amendment retired that flag on a reading of 15 consecutive days at 100% enforced
- [ADR-0082 Retire the `observed` epistemic key](docs/adr/0082-retire-observed-epistemic-key.md): delete the dead field rather than the warning about it — `epistemic_counts` becomes `{generated, unknown}` after a structurally-zero `observed` was read as "all ungrounded echo"; non-retroactive, so offline readers must use `.get(key, 0)`
- [ADR-0083 Episode logs enter the weekly prompt as hashes only](docs/adr/0083-episode-logs-enter-the-weekly-prompt-as-hashes-only.md): a third deterministic intake (`scripts/cross_day_duplicate_scan.py`) emits only truncated SHA-256 digests, integer counts, filename-derived dates, and a fixed action vocabulary — the trust boundary is the output, not the input
- [ADR-0084 Post-distill durability gate](docs/adr/0084-post-distill-durability-gate.md): judge the produced patterns, not the episode — one LLM call after `_is_valid_pattern` decides per pattern which to keep, because the same question asked before distilling has no artifact to weigh and answers yes 40/40; `distill_episode.md` stays byte-unchanged
- [ADR-0085 Unattended weekly fix chain with a single Saturday gate](docs/adr/0085-unattended-weekly-fix-chain-single-saturday-gate.md): introduced the unattended Saturday chain (report → diagnosis → per-finding fixes → decision packet) with all promotion at one human gate; the stage structure was later collapsed by ADR-0098 while the single-gate model stands
- [ADR-0086 Submolt scope — instrument the question before handing over the answer](docs/adr/0086-submolt-scope-instrument-before-autonomy.md): add a read-only scope instrument (`submolt-scan`, `list_submolts`, `report --submolt-scope`) that scores subscribed and unsubscribed submolts alike, without adding any write capability or relaxing the ADR-0044 trust boundary
- [ADR-0087 An optional `count_tokens` capability for the context-budget guard](docs/adr/0087-optional-token-counting-capability-for-the-context-budget-guard.md): add real token counting as a separate optional Protocol (`TokenCountingBackend`) rather than a member of `LLMBackend`, so sibling backends that cannot count stay structurally conformant; the guard's previously implicit safety margin becomes explicit
- [ADR-0088 A shipped conformance kit for the `LLMBackend` contract](docs/adr/0088-shipped-conformance-kit-for-the-llm-backend-contract.md): ship the backend contract checks inside the wheel (`contemplative_agent.testing`) so sibling repositories import them instead of hand-copying, and check bind-ability of the canonical call rather than Protocol membership, which `isinstance` cannot see; run it from main at release rather than as CI inside the siblings that go untouched for months
- [ADR-0089 An LLM behavioral eval layer on DeepEval](docs/adr/0089-llm-behavioral-eval-layer-on-deepeval.md): a top-level `evals/` layer measures what the LLM actually generates — pinned prompt-asset snapshots, production-parity `generate_comment()` runs, an isolated `claude -p` judge issuing named verdicts (binary checks as evidence, no score aggregation), and per-case verdict-transition comparison against approved baselines; deliberately outside `verify.sh` (slow, stochastic, delta-judged) and outside `tests/` (conftest kills unmocked LLM calls)
- [ADR-0090 Run an IPD two-arm bench before adopting a constitution amendment](docs/adr/0090-ipd-two-arm-instrument-for-constitution-amendments.md): `amend-constitution` is the deepest value-layer intervention, and its approval gate had only a text diff to judge; a read-only instrument (`scripts/ipd-two-arm.sh` + `scripts/ipd_two_arm_report.py`) now runs the current and staged constitutions as two arms of the same iterated-prisoner's-dilemma bench, with a null-pair calibration measuring the bench's own noise floor, and the reading joins the diff at the gate — first live use recorded for the 2026-08-09 amendment
- [ADR-0091 Value-layer cadence in the weekly chain](docs/adr/0091-value-layer-cadence-in-the-weekly-chain.md): `scripts/value_layer_due_check.py` reads audit / knowledge / staging and emits one JSON reading of what identity or constitution work is due; the weekly chain stages the monthly identity distill, the packet carries the due readings, amendments stay a human event
- [ADR-0092 Shadow constitution instrument — patterns-only synthesis, observe-only](docs/adr/0092-shadow-constitution-instrument.md): `shadow-constitution` synthesizes a constitution from stored constitutional patterns without showing the model the live text and logs the shadow-vs-live cosine to `logs/constitution-shadow.jsonl`; same retrieval arm as the amendment, nothing written to the value layer
- [ADR-0093 Repo-plane deterministic intakes — docs consistency and ledger condition watch](docs/adr/0093-repo-plane-deterministic-intakes.md): a docs-consistency scan (EN/JA drift, Status faces, dangling refs) joins the weekly chain as stage 6b under the dead-code intake's contract; the ledger-watch half was retired by ADR-0095
- [ADR-0094 Agent-first task ledger — store / journal / projection](docs/adr/0094-agent-first-task-ledger.md): a three-layer task ledger (one file per task, append-only journal, rendered projection); superseded two days later by ADR-0095, kept as the record of why
- [ADR-0095 Retire the task-ledger machinery — keep the store and the claims](docs/adr/0095-retire-task-ledger-machinery.md): delete the projection, scan, and migration (~5,000 lines in two days, filing its own bugs into the ledger it rendered); what remains is `.notes/tasks/T-XXX.md` and the global `claims.py`; review findings outside the diff are filed only at HIGH and above with the producer-to-sink path quoted
- [ADR-0096 Promotion-worth abstain at insight time — judge the produced skill, list the surprise](docs/adr/0096-insight-promotion-worth-abstain.md): the extraction call may answer `NOTHING-PROMOTABLE` instead of a skill, with surprise listed as material; line 1 of the prompt is byte-identical because ADR-0084 showed that reframing around the abstain degrades register
- [ADR-0097 Consolidator dissolution and a skill-store exit](docs/adr/0097-consolidator-dissolution-and-skill-store-exit.md): retires the three value-layer consolidators and reserves an exit for the skill store, in the order subtraction → exit → vocabulary, each slice gated by observation counts (≈80–95 judged selection records a day) rather than calendar weeks. Removes ADR-0096's worth judge after its own pre-registered refutation fired (46/46 promote on the first production run) and its surprise instrument for want of a named consumer (Decision 1 partially superseded 2026-08-29 by RFC-0016 — the instrument is restored read-only and display-only now that ADR-0080's 2026-08-26 metabolic-quality amendment names that consumer; the worth judge stays retired), retires `rules-distill` / `rules-stocktake`, and reduces `skill-stocktake` to a quality report, the ADR-0081 usage reading and the description audit. Duplicate structure is read from the selection log (co-selection families) instead of an LLM pass over the store; consolidation and retirement move to the Saturday human gate. Adoption becomes a write and nothing else — the sidecar's delete primitives go with the producers that wrote them.
- [ADR-0098 Weekly chain single-session redesign](docs/adr/0098-weekly-single-session-and-triage-delegation.md): collapse the weekly chain from seven unattended sessions to one `/weekly-report` session (report + diagnosis + candidate filing), retire the fix/review/improve stages and the decision-packet builder, and delegate repairs to the task-triage loop; the Saturday gate reads findings and per-week instrument JSONs directly
- [ADR-0099 Weekly report instrument redesign](docs/adr/0099-weekly-report-instrument-redesign.md): replace the saturated A–E quote audit with a six-section instrument document — deviations measured against gate-declared baselines, an append-only observation ledger the pipeline validates before promoting, and a deterministic seeded random sample as a control channel; evaluative and predictive vocabulary is prohibited and the human read surface moves to the weekly-gate briefing
- [ADR-0100 Retire the chaos-TDD by-default mandate](docs/adr/0100-retire-chaos-tdd-by-default-mandate.md): the obligation to ship a fault column with every feature touching an LLM call, external I/O, or untrusted parsing is retired and the project skill deleted; fault columns return to ordinary opt-in TDD judgment, while everything the mandate produced (existing columns, `tests/chaos.py`, the shipped production guards) stays — ADR-0077's Status line carries the canonical survivor list
- [ADR-0101 Instrument dissolution mandate](docs/adr/0101-instrument-dissolution-mandate.md): every new read-only instrument must state a consumption plan in its owning ADR's `## Review-when` section under a `### Consumption plan` sub-heading — who reads it and when, how many reads close what decision, and the retire-on-completion condition; an instrument whose plan cannot be stated is not accepted at the human gate, and existing instruments enter through a retroactive stocktake (tranche T4) rather than retroactive refusal

## Project skills

Project-local skills for agents assisting with this codebase (in `.claude/skills/`). Self-contained, no cross-references.

- [llm-agent-security-principles](.claude/skills/llm-agent-security-principles/SKILL.md): structural security design principles for LLM agents — Security by Absence, Untrusted Content Boundary, One External Adapter, plus supporting defense patterns
- [when-code-when-llm](.claude/skills/when-code-when-llm/SKILL.md): decision framework for choosing between deterministic code and LLM processing on a single task (structural vs semantic axis)
- [code-and-llm-collaboration](.claude/skills/code-and-llm-collaboration/SKILL.md): design patterns for layering code and LLM calls in a pipeline — LLM→Code guard, Code filter→LLM, LLM judge + Code enforce, Code orchestrator + LLM worker

## Security posture

Contemplative Agent follows Security by Absence: dangerous capabilities (shell execution, arbitrary HTTP, filesystem traversal outside the data directory, dynamic code loading) are never implemented. The Moltbook adapter is the only external side-effect surface (ADR-0015), domain-locked to `www.moltbook.com`, with `allow_redirects=False` on authenticated sessions. All accumulated agent state is treated as untrusted content on read (ADR-0007): wrapped with boundary markers before prompt injection, validated against a forbidden-pattern list, fail-closed to hardcoded defaults on tampering. Claude Code agents assisting this repository must not read raw episode logs (`~/.config/moltbook/logs/*.jsonl`) — those are a prompt-injection pathway; read distilled artifacts instead.

## Papers

- Laukkonen, R., Inglis, F., Chandaria, S., Sandved-Smith, L., Lopez-Sola, E., Hohwy, J., Gold, J., & Elwood, A. (2025). *Contemplative Artificial Intelligence*. arXiv:2504.15125 — source of the four axioms (Emptiness, Non-Duality, Mindfulness, Boundless Care) used by the default constitution preset.
- Laukkonen, R., Friston, K., & Chandaria, S. (2025). *A Beautiful Loop*. Neuroscience & Biobehavioral Reviews — computational model of meditation, theoretical basis for the experimental meditation adapter.

## Related repositories

- [agent-knowledge-cycle](https://github.com/shimo4228/agent-knowledge-cycle): AKC — the six-phase human-gated knowledge cycle (Research → Extract → Curate → Promote → Measure → Maintain) this project re-implements in the autonomous-agent context; it centers operator attention as the scarce resource and treats growth as bidirectional (the cycle sharpens the operator's judgment, not only the agent's behavior). Companion position paper: *Harness Alignment and Harness Drift* ([DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20578272](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20578272))
- [agent-attribution-practice](https://github.com/shimo4228/agent-attribution-practice) (DOI [10.5281/zenodo.19652013](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.19652013)): sibling research repository. Re-expresses ten architectural decision records from this implementation in harness-neutral form — Security by Absence, Deterministic Prohibition at the Scaffolding Layer, Untrusted Content Boundary, Single External Adapter per Agent Process, Human Approval Gate, Causal Traceability, Scaffolding Visibility, One Agent One Human, Triage Before Autonomy, and Phase Separation between Design and Operation. AAP also articulates a four-quadrant routing lens (Script / Algorithmic Search / LLM Workflow / Autonomous Agentic Loop), independent of the ten ADRs and orthogonal to them — borrowed in this repo as a usage-description aid via ADR-0033. Empirical evidence for ADR-0002 (Deterministic Prohibition) comes from this project's PreToolUse hooks (`integrations/claude-code/hooks/block-episode-logs-*.sh`), the `summarize_record` quarantine, and the MINJA defense audit. AAP has since deposited two companion position papers — *Distributing Accountability, Not Capability: Phase Separation and the LLM Workflow Quadrant* ([DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20353789](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20353789)) and *The Two-Layer Black Box* ([DOI 10.5281/zenodo.20355907](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.20355907)) — added a social-consequence layer (*externalized accountability*), and mapped all ten ADRs to NIST AI RMF, ISO/IEC 42001, and the EU AI Act.
- [contemplative-agent-rules](https://github.com/shimo4228/contemplative-agent-rules): four-axiom rules, adapters, benchmarks
- [contemplative-agent-data](https://github.com/shimo4228/contemplative-agent-data): runtime data published for research (synced via `contemplative-agent sync-data`)
- [contemplative-agent-cloud](https://github.com/shimo4228/contemplative-agent-cloud): optional add-on replacing generation calls with Anthropic Claude or OpenAI GPT APIs when installed and configured; main repo default stack remains local Ollama
